title: PL + PLL
headline: Over a dozen models for the perfect solution.
intro: Our latest pin-based LED retrofits now feature FlexColor allowing for substantial sku reduction and in-field adjustability. Ideal for PL applications, these lamps provide a long-lasting LED replacement for offices, hotels, lobbies, schools, and other commercial spaces.
callouts: Now w/ FlexColor — Extendable End Cap

features.label: UL Type A+B universal (ballast compatible or ballast bypass)
features.note: all 14 part numbers in the page 14 'PL | Universal | Type A+B' table: 7300 / 7310 / 7311 / 7312 / 7313 / 7314 / 7322 / 7316 / 7318 / 7328 / 7320 (FC1, FC2) / 7324 (FC1, FC2); page 12 line-up heading 'TYPE A + B'

features.label: FlexColor selectable CCT
features.note: all models except the fixed-CCT Type A lamps LED-7330 / LED-7334; CCT options per model are in the tables (no factory default is marked in bold in this catalog spread)

features.label: Extendable end cap
features.note: base can be extended by up to 1.0 in — 7316 / 7318 / 7328

features.label: Open fixture only
features.note: features glyph on all Type A+B lamps (LED-7300 to LED-7324) and Type A lamps (LED-7330 / LED-7334)

features.label: Enclosed fixture rated (may also be used in open fixture)
features.note: features glyph on all Type B lamps (LED-7340 / 7343 / 7344 / 7345 / 7350 / 7351)

features.label: Mounting: omni-directional / vertical / horizontal
features.note: per-model mounting glyph in the tables; see Mounting column

features.label: Emergency back up >90 min
